timing: The first exact-head workflow stopped on an impossible provider OHLC row before model fitting, threshold selection, simulated account PnL or any later-period opening.
failure_reason: At least one downloaded Bybit MT4 archive row violated candle geometry because its reported low exceeded another reported OHLC field.

frozen_correction.policy: Rows with non-positive prices, negative volume or impossible OHLC geometry are not repaired or reordered. Impossible-geometry rows are removed before exact-grid reindexing, their timestamps remain unavailable gaps, and each archive records the dropped-row count.
